pages.title: Summonable Helper
pages.text: Right-click to summon a combat doll at the spot you look at, up to 2 blocks ahead. The item is consumed, even in creative, and the number of active dolls is capped.

$(bold)Care and feeding$()$(br)Each doll stores its own health, shown as the item's durability bar, plus a name, a dye tint and a combat loadout. Right-click the doll item inside your inventory to open its loadout editor.$(br2)A doll at zero health is broken and refuses to deploy: repair it in an anvil using wool.
